dashboardView.subtitle: Actual cost of ownership and cost per {unit} for {name}

costBreakdownDonut.depreciationMissing: Depreciation is not entered: the slice is missing, not zero.

dataQualityCard.enterTheStartOdometerHint: Mileage driven before your first reading is not counted. Enter the odometer at purchase (vehicle ownership) so it is spread over the months.
dataQualityCard.enterAverageConsumptionHint: The distance driven without a recorded drive has no energy cost. Enter your average consumption and electricity rate to estimate it.
dataQualityCard.odometerRegression: Odometer lower than at the previous drive
dataQualityCard.distanceMismatch: Distance differs from the odometer reading
dataQualityCard.noScore: Not enough data to score the TCO yet
dataQualityCard.noScoreHint: Enter a drive, a charge or an expense and the score appears.
dataQualityCard.enterTheResaleAndHolding: Enter the resale value and holding period
dataQualityCard.capped: Capped below the ranking threshold: the depreciation is missing.

dimensions.energy_hybrid: Charges with a cost and fill-ups recorded
dimensions.distance_manual: Distance covered by readings and drives
dimensions.distance_fuel: Distance covered by readings and fill-ups
dimensions.distance_hybrid: Distance covered by readings, drives and fill-ups
dimensions.currency: Expenses converted to the vehicle currency

dataQualityCard.gapsHint: Largest gap first. Amounts are orders of magnitude from your own prices, not entered values.

energyBatterySection.batteryCapacityPerMonthTeslamate: Battery capacity per month: TeslaMate measurement and estimate from the charges
energyBatterySection.readAtEachSynchronizationIf: Read at each synchronization if TeslaMateApi exposes
energyBatterySection.kwhOutOfKwhThe: {value} kWh out of {value2} kWh, the best capacity observed (not the new-car capacity).
energyBatterySection.medianOfTheLastCharges: Median of the last {capacity_samples} charges of at least 30 battery points: energy added over percentage gained. A rough order of magnitude only.

energyEfficiencyPanel.derivedNote: Consumption and cost per 100 km are derived from your odometer readings and charges (energy added to the battery over the distance between readings), not measured by the car. Add readings regularly to keep them accurate.
energyEfficiencyPanel.theEnergyEfficiencyStatisticsCould: The energy efficiency statistics could not be loaded.
energyEfficiencyPanel.consumptionAndEnergyCostPer: Consumption and energy cost per month
energyEfficiencyPanel.monthlyEnergyCostPer100: Monthly energy cost per 100 {unit}, with a 3-month average
energyEfficiencyPanel.extrapolatedFromTheChargesWhose: Extrapolated from the charges whose cost and battery level are known.
energyEfficiencyPanel.energyStoredInTheBattery: Energy stored in the battery over energy drawn from the grid.
energyEfficiencyPanel.energyUsedWhileDrivingMeasured: Energy used while driving, as reported by the data source.
energyEfficiencyPanel.whatTheCarUsesAnd: What the car uses and what the energy really costs.
energyEfficiencyPanel.chargeSWithoutAKnown: {sessions_without_cost} charge(s) without a known cost: they are not counted in the cost per 100 {unit}.
energyEfficiencyPanel.thatIsKwhOnAverage: That is {price_per_kwh}/kWh on average when charging.
energyEfficiencyPanel.unknownDurationSessions: + {count} charge(s) with no known duration (manual entries), not shown above.
energyEfficiencyPanel.chargingEfficiencyEmpty: Efficiency compares the energy stored in the battery with the energy drawn from the grid (meter or charger). Charges synced by TeslaMate or an integration carry it; without it, the figure stays unknown.
energyEfficiencyPanel.noData: No efficiency data yet: it appears once odometer readings and charges cover the same period.
energyEfficiencyPanel.placeUnknown: {count} session(s) without a cost, not in the price

energyTemperatureSection.drivesOfAtLeast5: Drives of at least {min}, grouped by average outside temperature; bands under {band} are hidden.
energyTemperatureSection.averageConsumptionPer100Km: Average consumption per 100 {unit} by outside temperature

mileageCostChart.clickABarOfThe: Click a bar of the chart to open the month's detailed figures.

monthDetailModal.costBreakdownOfTheSelected: Cost breakdown of the selected month
monthDetailModal.fullBreakdownOfTheExpense: Full breakdown of the expense categories and cost per {unit}

contributions.show: Show the entries behind this amount
contributions.failed: The entries could not be loaded.
contributions.empty: No recorded entry for this month.
contributions.estimate: Estimated energy for {km} {unit} driven before tracking started ({kwh} kWh)
contributions.insuranceNote: Each payment is counted in the month it is paid; it is not spread over its coverage period.

monthlyCostChart.economicHint: Each cost spread over the period it covers.
monthlyCostChart.cashHint: What was paid in each month.

tagBreakdown.costBasis: Cost of the drives of each tag: energy, wear, insurance share and tolls, as in the drive list.
tagBreakdown.sharedNote: A drive with several tags counts in each of them: the tags can add up to more than the vehicle total.

tcoMetricsGrid.depreciationMissing: Depreciation not entered: the full cost leaves out the largest item.
tcoMetricsGrid.economicWindowLabel: Economic cost · last month | Economic cost · last {months} months

nextDueCard.title: Next maintenance
nextDueCard.othersSoon: +{count} other due soon | +{count} others due soon

donut.hintFull: Economic cost: tire wear spread over use, depreciation included.
donut.hintCash: Money actually paid: tires when bought, no depreciation.

breakdown.maintenanceBilledNote: {amount} billed by the workshop this month

batteryHealth.title: Battery health
batteryHealth.noHealth: Unknown for now: add a reading, or the capacity of the new battery to compare the charges with.
batteryHealth.healthHint: A reading can come from an OBD2 scan, a garage report, TeslaMate or the ingestion API. Otherwise the capacity estimated from your full charges is compared with that of the new battery.
batteryHealth.readingRequired: Enter a health percentage or the capacity of the new battery first.

resale.title: Estimated resale value
resale.progress: Share of the expected depreciation reached
resale.summary: {depreciation} lost so far · {progress} % of the expected depreciation
resale.curve: Projected value over the holding period
resale.missingTitle: Not enough information to estimate the value
resale.missingBody: Enter the purchase price, the expected resale value and the holding period in the ownership section of the vehicle.
resale.missingLeaseBody: Under a LOA the value comes from the contract. Fill in the following in the ownership section of the vehicle:
resale.notOwnable: A rental (LLD) is never owned by you, so there is no resale value to estimate.

field.lease_start_value: Value of the vehicle at the start of the contract
field.lease_end_value: Estimated market value at the end of the contract

resale.optionWorthIt: At the end of the contract the vehicle should be worth {amount} more than the purchase option.
resale.optionAboveValue: The purchase option is {amount} above the estimated value of the vehicle.
resale.optionHint: Before return fees and any mileage overage, which only apply if you return the vehicle.
resale.expectedKmHint: The odometer you expect when you sell. Left empty, it is extrapolated from your driving so far.
resale.advancedHint: The value combines age, mileage and battery health. These weights set the share of each: keep the defaults if unsure.
